name: GoodWe Technologies Co., Ltd.
summary: GoodWe Technologies Co., Ltd. engages in the research, manufacture, and sale of photovoltaic (PV) inverters and energy storage solutions in China and internationally. The company provides residential, commercial and industry, utility photovoltaic, photovoltaic building solutions; residential systems; and heat pump products. It also offers residential grid-tied inverters, commercial and industry-tied inverters, utility, residential energy storage, commercial and industry energy storage products. In addition, the company provides batteries, EV chargers, software and accessories, and PV building materials.
